review_history.rationale: Revise: growing/shrinking using the same number does not unequivocally distinguish proportional multiplication from equal additive dimension changes. Explicitly keep width/height quotient unchanged for each image, using standard division notation with both operands named. For example equal +10 to 100x50 would fail this invariant, whereas 200x100 satisfies it. Separate count label avoids count-versus-image-identifier ambiguity. Original-files and crop-settings invariance retained. Catalogue-only; future inserted axis noun and layout must be reassessed before wiring a consumer.
